description: StrucPy RCFA provides static elastic analysis of two- and three-dimensional reinforced-concrete frames. The StrucPy contributors publish it for structural-engineering education and research that needs direct access to analysis results. The module uses a stiffness-matrix method and accepts member, node, boundary and loading information through Python and Excel inputs. It calculates reactions, joint deflections and member forces, with diagrams and envelopes for load combinations. The model has no fixed geographic domain or historical period; spatial detail follows the supplied frame, and the documented analysis is static. GitHub and PyPI provide the code under LGPL-2.1, allowing free software reuse. Dependencies include NumPy, Pandas, Plotly, Ray and openpyxl. A material limitation is that the README lists dynamic seismic analysis and P-delta effects as under development. Those features should not be assumed available from this record. The package can support structural parameter studies and design optimisation. Related record model-opensees provides another structural-analysis system, with no verified interface between the packages. Repository validation claims were not independently reproduced.
